market.label: E-commerce personalization SaaS tools
market.input: a study of SaaS tools for e-commerce (marketplaces and online stores) used to personalize the products shown to the end consumer — which tools do e-commerce companies license to manage product personalization on their sites?
assumptions: Reading of the need: “personalizing the products shown to the end consumer” = personalization of the product EXPERIENCE — which products are shown to which visitor: recommendation engines, personalized search, individualized merchandising, commerce-oriented experimentation. Configurators for physical product customization (engraving, colors, print-on-demand — Zakeke, Customily…) are an adjacent market and are EXCLUDED; so are pure email marketing and off-site ad personalization.

Share measurement: share of estimated annual revenue (ARR or turnover, latest known, in US dollars) within a panel of 15 comparable specialist vendors (~1.58 billion $ combined — consistent with Gartner's 1.2 billion $ estimate for “personalization engines” alone in 2024, before the adjacent search/discovery segment). Most players being private, nearly every value is an estimate flagged “~”, of uneven reliability (noted player by player).

The integrated suites of the giants (Salesforce Einstein, Adobe Target/Sensei, SAP Emarsys) dominate part of the market but publish NO isolated figure for their personalization component: they are treated off-chart, as structuring forces, alongside the “build” alternatives (Amazon Personalize, Google Vertex AI Search).

Multi-product vendors: for Optimizely, Insider or Bloomreach, total ARR includes modules beyond strict e-commerce personalization (CMS, marketing automation, CDP). Shares should be read as “the vendor's economic weight in the personalization ecosystem”, not as revenue strictly limited to personalization.

reading.maturity_summary: A market entering consolidation, driven by two ground swells. The category is young but real: Gartner sizes “personalization engines” at 1.2 billion $ in 2024 (+26.1%) and devotes two distinct Magic Quadrants to it (Personalization Engines; Search & Product Discovery) — a sign that search and personalization are merging into a single battle for “product discovery”. The last 18 months concentrate the turning points: the Klevu+Searchspring merger → Athos Commerce (Jan. 2025), Monetate+SiteSpect (June 2025), AB Tasty+VWO orchestrated by Everstone (Jan. 2026, an entity above 100 M$ of ARR); the agentic-AI breakthrough (Algolia Agent Studio, Bloomreach Loomi, the ACP protocol from OpenAI/Stripe and Google's UCP, which move product discovery off the merchant's own site); and Google's privacy about-turn (Apr. 2025: third-party cookies stay in Chrome), which eases regulatory pressure on on-site personalization, natively first-party.

reference_period.rationale: The decisive events — the three mergers (Athos Jan. 2025, Monetate×SiteSpect June 2025, AB Tasty×VWO Jan. 2026), the agentic boom (ACP Sept. 2025, UCP Jan. 2026) and the latest published figures (Bloomreach above 260 M$, Coveo FY2026, Constructor +82% customers) — all fall within the last twelve to eighteen months. Three years would blend the pre-generative-AI era with the current one; six months would miss the early-2025 mergers.

dimensions.label: Functional breadth
dimensions.description: The market's fault line: point solution (search OR recommendations), product-discovery suite (search + recommendations + merchandising), or full experience platform (personalization + CDP + cross-channel orchestration).

dimensions.label: Customer target
dimensions.description: The buyer segment targeted first — it drives price, product and sales channel. SMB (Shopify, self-service), mid-market, or enterprise (large merchants, marketplaces).

dimensions.label: Entry price (k$/year)
dimensions.description: Annual cost of the real entry ticket (smallest typical contract): from ~0.6 k$/year (Doofinder) to ~150 k$/year (Constructor). The 1-to-250 spread segments customer bases radically.

dimensions.label: AI depth
dimensions.description: Degree of embedded AI: 0-4 rules and basic ML, 5-7 advanced ML (learned ranking, predictive segmentation), 8-10 generative and agentic AI in production (conversational shopping assistants, agents).

dimensions.label: Pricing model
dimensions.description: How the vendor bills: subscription (fixed tiers, often indexed on traffic/SKUs), usage-based (queries, records), or % of revenue generated (performance).

reading.default_config_rationale: Functional breadth ranks first: it is what separates the point solutions (Algolia, Constructor, Doofinder), the product-discovery suites (Nosto, Athos, Coveo) and the experience platforms (Insider, Bloomreach, Optimizely) — it is assigned to the Y axis, overridden by default by market share (switch Y to “Functional breadth” for the structural view). Customer target (rank 2, X axis + color) shows the real commercial segmentation: the further right and the darker a marker, the larger the buyer targeted. Entry price (rank 3, size) makes the 1-to-250 spread visible at a glance: the big markers are the enterprise tickets. AI depth (rank 4, opacity) and pricing model (rank 5, border) complete the reading.
reading.export_note: Global market for e-commerce personalization SaaS tools (recommendations, personalized search, individualized merchandising), read as of 29 July 2026. Height = share of the estimated revenue of a panel of 15 specialist vendors (~1.58 billion $ combined); horizontal position = estimated 12-month change in share; all values ~estimated. First observation: the market is consolidating fast (three mergers in eighteen months — Athos Commerce, Monetate×SiteSpect, AB Tasty×VWO) while growth concentrates on the AI-native players of product discovery (Constructor, ARR ×8 in 2024) — and the integrated giants (Salesforce, Adobe, SAP), off-chart for lack of isolated figures, cap the field from above.

values_methodology.label: Market share (%)
values_methodology.note: Share of the vendor's estimated annual revenue (ARR or turnover, latest known) within a panel of 15 specialist vendors totalling ~1.58 billion $. All source revenues are in US dollars, except Algonomy (Indian regulatory filings in INR, converted at ~83 INR/USD) and AB Tasty×VWO (combined figure announced in $). Indicative proxy: the panel excludes the giants' integrated suites (no isolated figure) — shares read within the specialist ecosystem, not the total market.

values_methodology.label: 12-month change (%)
values_methodology.note: Estimated 12-month change in market share: the player's revenue growth relative to the market's (~+20%/year — Gartner: +26.1% in 2024 for personalization engines; analyst ranges 12-36%). A negative value means the player is growing more slowly than the market.

values_methodology.label: Functional breadth
values_methodology.note: Qualitative category: point solution (search OR recommendations, embeddable anywhere) / discovery suite (search + recommendations + product merchandising) / experience platform (personalization + CDP + cross-channel orchestration, beyond the site).

values_methodology.label: Customer target
values_methodology.note: Priority buyer segment, inferred from public pricing and the customer base: SMB (self-service, Shopify apps, under 1 k$/month) / mid-market / enterprise (contracts of 40 k$+/year, large merchants and marketplaces).

values_methodology.label: Entry price (k$/year)
values_methodology.note: Thousands of US dollars per year, smallest typical contract observed: public pricing pages where they exist (Doofinder 49 $/month, Rebuy 99 $/month, Athos 699 $/month), procurement data (Vendr, mida.so) otherwise (Constructor ~150 k$/year, AB Tasty ~20-50 k$/year). €→$ conversions at ~1 € = 1.09 $. Excludes implementation costs and add-on modules.

values_methodology.label: AI depth
values_methodology.note: Score assigned by the agent from documented capabilities: 0-4 = rules and basic ML; 5-7 = advanced ML (learned ranking, predictive); 8-10 = generative/agentic AI in production (Algolia Agent Studio, Bloomreach Loomi, Optimizely Opal).

values_methodology.label: Pricing model
values_methodology.note: Qualitative category: subscription (fixed tiers, often indexed on traffic/SKUs/orders) / usage-based (billed on queries and records — Algolia, and the AWS/Google “build” route) / % of revenue generated (Nosto's performance model: 2.5-4% of attributed sales).

lexicon.fr: Moteur logiciel qui adapte en temps réel les produits, contenus ou offres montrés à chaque visiteur selon son comportement et ses données — la catégorie au cœur de ce rapport (Gartner : 1,2 Md$ en 2024).
lexicon.en: Software engine that adapts in real time which products, content or offers each visitor sees, based on behavior and data — the category at the core of this report.

lexicon.fr: L'ensemble des mécanismes qui aident un visiteur à trouver le bon produit : recherche, filtres, recommandations, merchandising. Gartner en a fait un Magic Quadrant distinct en 2024.
lexicon.en: The mechanisms helping a shopper find the right product: search, filtering, recommendations, merchandising. Gartner made it a separate Magic Quadrant in 2024.

lexicon.fr: Système qui suggère des produits à partir du comportement du visiteur, de son profil ou de la similarité entre produits (« vous aimerez aussi »).
lexicon.en: System suggesting products based on visitor behavior, profile, or product similarity (« you may also like »).

lexicon.fr: Mise en avant, tri et exclusion de produits dans les pages de recherche et de catégorie — manuelle, par règles, ou pilotée par IA.
lexicon.en: Promoting, ranking and excluding products within search and category pages — manually, by rules, or AI-driven.

lexicon.fr: Recherche produit fournie comme service cloud par API (Algolia, Constructor, Doofinder), plutôt que développée en interne.
lexicon.en: Product search delivered as a cloud API service (Algolia, Constructor, Doofinder) rather than built in-house.

lexicon.fr: Comparer deux versions d'une page ou d'un parcours sur des visiteurs différents pour mesurer laquelle convertit le mieux — le cœur de métier d'AB Tasty, VWO, Kameleoon, SiteSpect.
lexicon.en: Showing two versions of a page to different visitors to measure which converts better — the core of AB Tasty, VWO, Kameleoon, SiteSpect.

lexicon.fr: Plateforme qui unifie les données client de toutes les sources (site, app, CRM, caisse) en un profil unique exploitable par la personnalisation.
lexicon.en: Platform unifying customer data from all sources into a single profile usable for personalization.

lexicon.fr: Architectures découplant le front-end du moteur e-commerce (headless), assemblées en briques best-of-breed (composable) selon le standard MACH — le terrain le plus favorable aux éditeurs indépendants.
lexicon.en: Architectures decoupling the storefront from the commerce engine (headless), assembled from best-of-breed blocks (composable) per the MACH standard — the friendliest ground for independent vendors.

lexicon.fr: Données observées sur son propre site (first-party) ou déclarées volontairement par le client (zero-party) — le carburant de la personnalisation on-site, peu dépendant des cookies tiers.
lexicon.en: Data observed on one's own site (first-party) or intentionally shared by the customer (zero-party) — the fuel of on-site personalization, barely dependent on third-party cookies.

lexicon.fr: Achats initiés ou conduits par un agent IA au nom du consommateur, potentiellement hors du site marchand (ex. dans ChatGPT) — la frontière qui bouge en 2025-2026.
lexicon.en: Purchases initiated or carried out by an AI agent on the shopper's behalf, potentially outside the merchant site (e.g. inside ChatGPT) — the moving frontier of 2025-2026.

lexicon.fr: Les deux protocoles concurrents du commerce agentique : Agentic Commerce Protocol (Stripe + OpenAI, sept. 2025 — achat direct dans ChatGPT) et Universal Commerce Protocol (Google + Shopify/Walmart/Target, janv. 2026).
lexicon.en: The two competing agentic-commerce protocols: ACP (Stripe + OpenAI, Sept. 2025 — buying inside ChatGPT) and UCP (Google + Shopify/Walmart/Target, Jan. 2026).

lexicon.fr: Arbitrage entre développer sa personnalisation en interne (Amazon Personalize, Google Vertex AI Search — facturés à l'usage) et acheter un SaaS spécialisé — l'alternative qui plafonne les prix du marché.
lexicon.en: The tradeoff between building personalization in-house (Amazon Personalize, Google Vertex AI Search — usage-billed) and buying specialized SaaS — the alternative that caps market prices.

lexicon.fr: Volume d'affaires transitant par un site marchand — l'assiette du modèle « % du revenu généré » de Nosto et des revenue-shares de plateformes.
lexicon.en: Merchandise volume flowing through a store — the base for Nosto's revenue-share model and platform revenue shares.

lexicon.fr: Valeur annuelle d'un contrat client. Sur ce marché : de ~600 $/an (Doofinder Basic) à ~430 k$/an (Bloomreach haut de gamme) — un écart de 1 à 700.
lexicon.en: Annual value of a customer contract. In this market: from ~$600/yr (Doofinder Basic) to ~$430k/yr (high-end Bloomreach) — a 1-to-700 spread.

lexicon.fr: Revenu récurrent annuel / rétention nette du revenu (médiane SaaS ~101 % en 2024) / taux d'attrition — les trois métriques de santé d'un éditeur SaaS.
lexicon.en: Annual recurring revenue / net revenue retention (SaaS median ~101% in 2024) / attrition rate — the three health metrics of a SaaS vendor.

lexicon.fr: Référence produit unique. La taille du catalogue (en SKU) est un facteur clé de tarification et le critère d'entrée des outils enterprise (Constructor : >100 000 SKU).
lexicon.en: Unique product reference. Catalog size (in SKUs) is a key pricing factor and the entry criterion of enterprise tools (Constructor: >100,000 SKUs).

lexicon.fr: Les classements d'analystes qui structurent les achats enterprise : Gartner distingue depuis 2024 DEUX quadrants — Personalization Engines et Search & Product Discovery — signe de la fusion des deux mondes.
lexicon.en: The analyst rankings that shape enterprise buying: since 2024 Gartner runs TWO quadrants — Personalization Engines and Search & Product Discovery — a sign the two worlds are merging.
